name: James Connolly
role: Irish socialist republican, labor organizer and Easter Rising leader
summary: Connolly joined Irish independence to common ownership and democratic workers’ control. He supported women’s emancipation, nonsectarian socialist politics and industrial unionism, ultimately combining labor organization with armed rebellion against British rule.
